reference: He has a plan. He is going to walk her home.
sk: Má plán. Chystá sa odprevadiť ju domov.
cz: Má plán. Chystá se doprovodit ji domů.
acceptable: He {has|has got} a plan. He is going to {walk|take|see|accompany} her {|back} home.

mistakes.text: He has a plan. He going to walk her home.
He has a plan. He is going to walks her home.
He has a plan. He is going walk her home.
He has a plan. He will {walk|take} her home.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Keď už je plán, patrí „is going to“, nie „will“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Když už je plán, patří „is going to“, ne „will“.

mistakes.text: He has a plan. He is going to {walk|take} her to home.
